# Community subsets

```{r status_labels}
# Load invasive status predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

set.seed(1337)
```

```{r community_subsets}
# ---- community table aligned to Oʻahu ----
comm_all <- zotu_df %>%
  semi_join(meta_oahu %>% select(sample_id), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(across(-sample_id, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))  # ensure numeric

# ---- map NIClassify status to ASV columns (case-insensitive) ----
status_map <- status %>%
  transmute(zotu_id_l = tolower(zotu_id),
            status_final_l = tolower(status_ni)) %>%
  filter(status_final_l %in% c("native","introduced")) %>%
  distinct()

z_cols <- setdiff(names(comm_all), "sample_id")
z_map <- tibble(zotu_id_raw = z_cols,
                zotu_id_l   = tolower(z_cols)) %>%
  left_join(status_map, by = "zotu_id_l")

z_native <- z_map %>% filter(status_final_l == "native") %>% pull(zotu_id_raw)
z_intro  <- z_map %>% filter(status_final_l == "introduced") %>% pull(zotu_id_raw)

# ---- split by status using tidyselect and joins ----
comm_native <- comm_all %>%
  select(sample_id, any_of(z_native)) %>%
  semi_join(meta_oahu %>% select(sample_id), by = "sample_id")

comm_intro <- comm_all %>%
  select(sample_id, any_of(z_intro)) %>%
  semi_join(meta_oahu %>% select(sample_id), by = "sample_id")

# ---- metadata subset with safe ridge fallback and alignment ----
meta_use <- meta_oahu %>%
  select(sample_id, elevation_m, sample_site) %>%
  mutate(ridge = coalesce(as.character(sample_site), "all_oahu")) %>%
  mutate(ridge = factor(ridge)) %>%
  semi_join(
    bind_rows(
      comm_native %>% select(sample_id),
      comm_intro  %>% select(sample_id)
    ) %>% distinct(),
    by = "sample_id"
  )
```

# Ridge structure and multivariate dispersion

```{r status_dispersion}
library(vegan)
library(permute)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------
# A) Strict sample-order checks
# ---------------------------
if (!"sample_id" %in% names(comm_native) || !"sample_id" %in% names(comm_intro)) {
  stop("comm_native and comm_intro must each include a sample_id column.")
}
if (!all(c("sample_id", "ridge") %in% names(meta_use))) {
  stop("meta_use must include sample_id and ridge columns.")
}

sample_ids_native <- comm_native$sample_id
sample_ids_intro  <- comm_intro$sample_id
sample_ids_meta   <- meta_use$sample_id

if (!identical(sample_ids_native, sample_ids_intro)) {
  stop("Sample order mismatch: comm_native vs comm_intro.")
}

# Allow safe reordering of metadata if IDs match as a set
if (!identical(sample_ids_native, sample_ids_meta)) {
  if (!setequal(sample_ids_native, sample_ids_meta)) {
    stop("Sample IDs mismatch: community tables and metadata contain different samples.")
  }
  meta_use <- meta_use %>%
    mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id)) %>%
    slice(match(sample_ids_native, sample_id))
  message("Reordered metadata to match community-table sample order.")
}

# ---------------------------
# B) Bray-Curtis from community matrices (NOT NMDS coordinates)
# ---------------------------
native_mat <- comm_native %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

intro_mat <- comm_intro %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

native_bray <- vegdist(native_mat, method = "bray")
intro_bray  <- vegdist(intro_mat, method = "bray")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C + D) Compare dispersion (introduced vs native), ridge-aware
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build one combined matrix in a common feature space (native + intro ASVs),
# duplicating samples once per status. This allows direct PERMDISP by status.
native_df <- as.data.frame(native_mat)
intro_df  <- as.data.frame(intro_mat)

all_asvs <- union(colnames(native_df), colnames(intro_df))
native_df <- native_df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
intro_df  <- intro_df  %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

align_to_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, colnames(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    for (m in miss) df[[m]] <- 0
  }
  df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}

native_common <- align_to_cols(native_df, all_asvs)
intro_common  <- align_to_cols(intro_df, all_asvs)
native_common[is.na(native_common)] <- 0
intro_common[is.na(intro_common)] <- 0

combined_mat <- rbind(native_common, intro_common)
rownames(combined_mat) <- c(
  paste0(rownames(native_common), "__native"),
  paste0(rownames(intro_common), "__introduced")
)

status_group <- factor(
  c(rep("native", nrow(native_common)), rep("introduced", nrow(intro_common))),
  levels = c("native", "introduced")
)
ridge_group <- factor(rep(as.character(meta_use$ridge), 2))

combined_bray <- vegdist(combined_mat, method = "bray")
dispersion_by_status <- betadisper(combined_bray, group = status_group, type = "centroid")

# Main permutation test: restrict permutations within ridge blocks
perm_ctrl <- how(nperm = 9999, blocks = ridge_group)
dispersion_perm <- permutest(dispersion_by_status, permutations = perm_ctrl)

# Distances-to-centroid summaries to report
dispersion_dist <- tibble(
  status = status_group,
  distance_to_centroid = dispersion_by_status$distances
)
dispersion_summary <- dispersion_dist %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_distance = mean(distance_to_centroid, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_distance = median(distance_to_centroid, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_distance = sd(distance_to_centroid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------
# E) Ridge structure in each subset
# ---------------------------
adonis_native_ridge <- adonis2(native_bray ~ ridge, data = meta_use, permutations = 9999)
adonis_intro_ridge  <- adonis2(intro_bray  ~ ridge, data = meta_use, permutations = 9999)

# Print compact outputs
cat("\n=== PERMDISP: status (native vs introduced), permutations blocked within ridge ===\n")
print(dispersion_perm)
cat("\n=== Distance-to-centroid summary by status ===\n")
print(dispersion_summary)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: native communities ~ ridge ===\n")
print(adonis_native_ridge)
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: introduced communities ~ ridge ===\n")
print(adonis_intro_ridge)
```

# Figure 3: native and introduced ordinations

```{r status_ordination_function}
nmds_sites_status <- function(comm_tbl, meta_use, status_label, meta_full = NULL) {
  # align to meta
  X <- comm_tbl %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(meta_use, by = "sample_id") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(sample_id)

  mat <- X %>%
    dplyr::select(-sample_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(dplyr::everything(),
                         ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
    as.matrix()
  rownames(mat) <- X$sample_id

  # drop all-zero columns
  nz <- colSums(mat) > 0
  mat <- mat[, nz, drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(mat) < 3 || ncol(mat) == 0) return(NULL)

  dist_bc <- vegan::vegdist(mat, method = "bray")
  ord     <- vegan::metaMDS(dist_bc, k = 2, trymax = 100)
  stress_pct <- round(ord$stress, 2) * 100

  scores_df <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display = "sites"))
  scores_df$sample_id <- rownames(scores_df)

  scores_df <- scores_df %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble()

  ## ---- robust axis naming ----
  # Older vegan: MDS1/MDS2; newer: NMDS1/NMDS2.
  if ("MDS1" %in% names(scores_df)) {
    scores_df <- scores_df %>%
      dplyr::rename(NMDS1 = MDS1, NMDS2 = MDS2)
  }

  # now NMDS1 / NMDS2 definitely exist
  out <- scores_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta_use, by = "sample_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      status = status_label,
      stress_pct = stress_pct
    )

  ## ---- optional: bring in elev_band / elev_arrow from full meta ----
  if (!is.null(meta_full) && all(c("elev_band") %in% names(meta_full))) {
    elev_lookup <- meta_full %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, elev_band) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        elev_arrow = dplyr::case_when(
          elev_band == "High" ~ "\u25B2",  # ▲
          elev_band == "Mid"  ~ "\u25A0",  # ■
          elev_band == "Low"  ~ "\u25BC"   # ▼
        )
      )

    out <- out %>%
      dplyr::left_join(elev_lookup, by = "sample_id")
  }

  out
}
```

```{r status_ordinations}
nmds_sites_native <- nmds_sites_status(comm_native, meta_use, "native", meta_oahu)
nmds_sites_intro  <- nmds_sites_status(comm_intro , meta_use, "introduced", meta_oahu)
nmds_stress_native <- unique(nmds_sites_native$stress_pct)[1]
nmds_stress_intro  <- unique(nmds_sites_intro$stress_pct)[1]

  elev_band = factor(c("High","Mid","Low"), levels = c("High","Mid","Low")),
  NMDS1 = 1e6, NMDS2 = 1e6
)

hull_data_status_split_native <-
  nmds_sites_native  %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(sample_site) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(status, sample_site) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 3) %>%
  dplyr::slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


hull_data_status_split_intro <-
  nmds_sites_intro  %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(sample_site) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(status, sample_site) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 3) %>%
  dplyr::slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

# Figure S5: distance decay within ridges

```{r status_distance_decay}
# coords from meta (lon = coord_x, lat = coord_y)
meta_coords <- meta_use %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, ridge) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_oahu %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, coord_x, coord_y),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(coord_x), !is.na(coord_y)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --- robust distance helper: works for degrees or projected meters ---
dist_km_from_meta <- function(df_xy) {
  stopifnot(all(c("coord_x","coord_y") %in% names(df_xy)))
  deg_like <- all(df_xy$coord_x >= -180 & df_xy$coord_x <= 180 &
                  df_xy$coord_y >=  -90 & df_xy$coord_y <=  90)

  coords <- as.matrix(df_xy[, c("coord_x","coord_y")])

  if (deg_like) {
    # lon,lat in degrees -> great-circle distance (km)
    geosphere::distm(coords, fun = geosphere::distHaversine) / 1000
  } else {
    # projected meters -> Euclidean (km)
    as.matrix(stats::dist(coords, method = "euclidean")) / 1000
  }
}

coords_df <- meta_coords %>%
  dplyr::select(coord_x, coord_y)

dist_km <- dist_km_from_meta(coords_df)

pairwise_decay <- function(comm_tbl, label) {
  comm_tbl <- comm_tbl %>% dplyr::semi_join(meta_coords, by = "sample_id")

  ridges_here <- meta_coords %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(comm_tbl, by = "sample_id") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ridge) %>%
    dplyr::pull(ridge)

  purrr::map_dfr(ridges_here, function(r) {
    ids <- meta_coords %>%
      dplyr::filter(ridge == r, sample_id %in% comm_tbl$sample_id) %>%
      dplyr::pull(sample_id)

    if (length(ids) < 2) return(tibble::tibble())

    X <- comm_tbl %>%
      dplyr::semi_join(tibble::tibble(sample_id = ids), by = "sample_id") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(match(sample_id, ids))

    mat <- X %>%
      dplyr::select(-sample_id) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(dplyr::everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
      as.matrix()
    rownames(mat) <- X$sample_id

    nz <- colSums(mat) > 0
    mat <- mat[, nz, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(mat) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

    bc <- as.matrix(vegan::vegdist(mat, method = "bray"))

    coords_df <- meta_coords %>%
      dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% ids) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(match(sample_id, ids)) %>%
      dplyr::select(coord_x, coord_y)

    dist_km <- dist_km_from_meta(coords_df)

    upper <- which(upper.tri(bc), arr.ind = TRUE)
    tibble::tibble(
      ridge    = r,
      site1    = ids[upper[,1]],
      site2    = ids[upper[,2]],
      bc       = bc[upper],
      dist_km  = dist_km[upper],
      status   = label
    )
  })
}

# build pairwise tables for both statuses
dd_native_pairs <- pairwise_decay(comm_native, "native")
dd_intro_pairs  <- pairwise_decay(comm_intro , "introduced")
dd_pairs        <- dplyr::bind_rows(dd_native_pairs, dd_intro_pairs) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(bc), is.finite(dist_km), dist_km > 0)

# slope per ridge and status (Bray–Curtis ~ log10 distance)
slopes <- dd_pairs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(status, ridge) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    slope = coef(lm(bc ~ log10(dist_km)))[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(slopes)

# Compare ridge-specific slopes by status.
mod_E <- stats::lm(slope ~ status, data = slopes)
print(summary(mod_E))  # statusnative coefficient: more negative = steeper native decay

# ---- Figures ----

# 1) Slope comparison (publication panel)
pE_slopes <- ggplot2::ggplot(slopes, ggplot2::aes(x = status, y = slope, fill = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, color = "grey30", alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    y = "Slope of Bray–Curtis vs log10(distance km)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")


# 2) Pairwise distances and fitted lines by status
pE_scatter <- ggplot2::ggplot(dd_pairs, ggplot2::aes(x = log10(dist_km), y = bc, color = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.0) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C")) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "log10 geographic distance (km)", y = "Bray–Curtis dissimilarity") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12)

pE_panel <- pE_slopes + pE_scatter +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
              tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ')') &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 16))

# Export Figure S5.
save_fig(
  tag    = "S5_distance_decay_invasive_noninvasive",
  plot   = pE_panel,
  which  = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width  = 10,
  height = 5
)
```
